title: Gérard Depardieu and Michel Houellebecq investigated over on-set rape and assault allegations
summary_full: Actor and author are alleged to have attacked and gang-raped a woman while filming together in 2018French police are investigating allegations that the actor Gérard Depardieu and the author Michel Houellebecq gang-raped and assaulted a woman during a 2018 film shoot.The alleged attack took place in December 2018 during the shooting of Thalasso, a film starring the two men as versions of themselves who meet at a health spa and have long philosophical conversations while in white bath-robes.
